name: Just War
overview: The Bible acknowledges the reality of war as part of God's sovereign plan, describing the LORD as a warrior who empowers His people for battle (Exodus 15:3; Psalms 144:1). Scripture encourages trust in God's presence and strength even when facing overwhelming enemies (Deuteronomy 20:1), while also recognizing that there is a divinely appointed time for both war and peace (Ecclesiastes 3:8). Christ’s teaching calls believers to pursue peace and love their enemies, highlighting the tension between just warfare and the higher calling to be peacemakers and to pray for those who oppose us (Matthew 5:9, 44).
